shared.cloud_sync_privacy_body:
When cloud sync is enabled, your school-system password and Moodle token are encrypted and uploaded to the TigerDuck server, where they are used to periodically fetch Moodle assignments on your behalf and to sync timetable edits, assignment states, and settings across your devices.

You can disable cloud sync at any time. Disabling signs this device out and revokes its registration on the server (including push credentials); uploaded account credentials stay on the server only while other synced devices still use them. Local data is not affected.

android.live_activity_channel_description: Shows current class, upcoming class, and assignment countdowns. You can adjust scenario sounds in app settings.
android.live_activity_settings_description: Live Updates shows the current class and countdown in notifications. "In class" and "Class starting soon" update in real time only while the app is open; "Assignment warning" can still alert on time when the app is closed.
android.live_activity_settings_permissions_hint: Notifications and exact alarms are required to deliver reminders; disabling battery restrictions helps reminders arrive on time when the app is closed or in background.
android.live_activity_settings_sound_hint: A sound plays only when entering a scenario for the first time; later countdown updates stay silent. To adjust volume or Do Not Disturb behavior, change the "Live Updates" notification channel in system settings.

android.onboarding_flavor_fdroid_description:
You're using the F-Droid build. Because F-Droid policy forbids depending on Google's services (Firebase FCM, GMS, etc.), the following two features are unavailable in this build:

1. Wear OS companion app
2. Real-time push announcements
android.onboarding_flavor_play_description: TigerDuck includes a Wear OS companion. View class messages on your watch — Wear TigerDuck syncs information from your phone.
android.permission_battery_optimization_descript: In system battery/background settings, set TigerDuck to unrestricted (or don't restrict background activity) to reduce reminder delays.
android.permission_exact_alarm_description: Allow the app to send assignment and class reminders at exact times. If disabled, reminders may be delayed by several minutes.
android.permission_notifications_description: Allow the app to show notifications; otherwise notifications and Live Updates will not appear.

android.vibration_settings_motor_warning: Some phones have lower-quality vibration motors that may ignore very weak or very short vibrations. If you can't feel a setting, try raising its strength or length. You can start by trying the medium preset first.
